Title: Locked-test stock-level OOS R-squared by model
Main takeaway: All preregistered models beat the zero-return squared-error benchmark; Random Forest was highest but this does not imply profitable ranking.

Title: Random Forest prediction sorts were not monotonic
Main takeaway: Predictions rose mechanically across bins, but realized returns did not; the bottom decile outperformed the top decile.

Title: Random Forest cross-sectional rank IC was unstable
Main takeaway: Mean and median rank IC were negative, and only 38.2% of test months had positive rank IC.

Title: Random Forest D10-minus-D1 portfolio lost money over the locked test
Main takeaway: Positive stock-level OOS R-squared did not translate into profitable equal-weight prediction sorts.

Title: Costs weakened an already negative Random Forest spread
Main takeaway: The gross spread was already negative; higher cost assumptions only increased the loss.
